name: Asgard subsea gas compression, Norwegian Sea
description: world's first subsea gas compression facility; on stream 17 Sep 2015; phase 2 started 2025 (first module replaced 2023, second installed at 270 m); recovery from Mikkel and Midgard rising to 90%, about 306 million boe additional, about NOK 175 bn added value

sources.note: Equinor, 26 Sep 2025 (phase 2 start, recovery to 90%, 306 Mboe); Aker Solutions project page (delivered world's first system in 2015); read 2026-10-28
